import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong features based on t-statistics
    t_stats = np.array([stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                       feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[0] 
                       for fid in feats.ids])
    
    # Select top features by absolute t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(np.abs(t_stats))[::-1][:20]
    top_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(top_ids):
        is_duplicate = False
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(keep):
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid1)], 
                              feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            keep.append(fid1)
    
    # Cluster remaining features to find modules
    if len(keep) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
        
    # Use cosine similarity to cluster
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep]]
    sim_matrix = cosine_similarity(X)
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=min(3, len(keep)), linkage='average')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1-sim_matrix)
    
    # Select best cluster (highest average t-stat)
    best_cluster = np.argmax([np.mean([t_stats[feats.column(fid)] for fid in keep if clusters[i]==j]) 
                             for j in set(clusters)])
    
    # Get features in best cluster
    module_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(keep) if clusters[i] == best_cluster]
    
    # If we have a strong module, create a weighted score
    if len(module_features) >= 2:
        # Simple weighted sum based on t-statistics
        weights = np.array([abs(t_stats[feats.column(fid)]) for fid in module_features])
        weights = weights / np.sum(weights)
        loadings = dict(zip(module_features, weights))
        
        # Return design with module features
        return Design(
            drivers=tuple(module_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
            columns=tuple(module_features),
            products=(),
            loadings=loadings
        )
    
    # No strong module found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
